mapper.sql: r.id AS id, r.order_key AS orderKey, r.company_seq AS companySeq, r.total_price AS totalPrice, r.delivery_date AS deliveryDate, r.status AS status, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "order" (order_key, company_seq, total_price, delivery_date, status) VALUES (#{orderKey}, #{companySeq}, #{totalPrice}, #{deliveryDate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM "order" AS r WHERE r.order_key = #{orderKey} FOR UPDATE
